deepseek.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: production four-pose desktop-pet reference sheet on TRUE TRANSPARENT background.
INPUT 1 is the USER'S STYLE TARGET: copy its squat tiny desktop sprite proportions and quiet hand-drawn 2D cel look, compact silhouette, large round head, tiny very short torso and stubby feet, sleepy half-lidded eyes, dark slightly soft contours, muted low-contrast navy colors and two simple shadow tones. Do NOT copy its low resolution or white background.
INPUT 2 is ONLY the character identity/outfit reference. Completely REDRAW this identity in input 1's approximately 1.9 to 2.0-heads-tall shape. The previous input 2 is TOO TALL, TOO DETAILED, TOO SHINY. Head and rounded hair mass occupy about 52 percent of height excluding ahoge; torso+short bell skirt+tiny feet together only 48 percent. No elongated neck, long legs, or slender body. No glossy doll/3D/painting rendering. This is a small soft 2D anime desktop sprite, not polished collectible illustration.
DeepSeek whale maid: muted denim-navy hair, rounded compact waves ending beside skirt, a single curved ahoge, blue relaxed eyes, white maid headband, small whale-fin side ornaments; short navy/white frilled maid bell dress, simple oval white apron with ONE tiny blue whale motif, white socks and two tiny dark rounded shoes. Exactly one short navy whale tail attached to lower back. Minimize tiny gold ornaments and curls.
LAYOUT: one wide sheet, FOUR separate non-overlapping full-body figures in a single row, equal size and same head proportions, spacious transparent gaps. Left to right: (1) exact FRONT neutral standing, both arms resting down, feet side by side, mouth closed, eyes open; (2) true LEFT-facing profile neutral standing; (3) true BACK view neutral standing with correct rear bow and whale tail; (4) FRONT SUSPENDED drag pose of the SAME character, arms slightly out then relaxed dangling wrists, tiny feet dangling with toes down and knees slightly relaxed, a mildly puzzled face, hanging posture DIFFERENT from standing, no hand holding her, no ropes, no ground. All 4 same outfit and attachment counts.
Draw high enough resolution to downsample cleanly but REDUCE texture and fussy micro detail to match input 1. Whole heads including ahoge and whole shoes/tails visible. No props, extra characters, words, labels, logos, watermark, scene, ground, cast shadow, white matte, or checkerboard pattern. Deliver actual alpha transparency.
